Name: Delete Partition
Description: Delete an existing partition from a disk. WARNING: This will permanently remove all data on the selected partition.

Params.name: DeleteInfo
Params.default:
[WARNING]
This operation will permanently delete the selected partition and ALL DATA on it!
- Always back up important data before deleting
- Use WhatIf mode to preview the operation
- Verify disk and partition numbers carefully
- Cannot be undone!

Params.name: DiskNumber
Params.label: Select Disk
Params.description: Select the disk containing the partition to delete

Params.name: PartitionNumber
Params.label: Select Partition
Params.description: Select the partition to delete (automatically populated based on disk selection)
